hints.en: `let me = ManuallyDrop::new(self);` then copy the fields into `IntoIter`.

tests.code: let mut v = MyVec::new(); v.push(1); v.push(2); assert_eq!(v.into_iter().collect::<Vec<i32>>(), vec![1, 2]);

let a = std::rc::Rc::new(()); let mut v = MyVec::new(); for _ in 0..3 { v.push(a.clone()); } let mut it = v.into_iter(); let first = it.next(); assert_eq!(std::rc::Rc::strong_count(&a), 4); drop(it); assert_eq!(std::rc::Rc::strong_count(&a), 2); drop(first); assert_eq!(std::rc::Rc::strong_count(&a), 1);
